verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a cloud-hosted AI media platform with a public API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency choices, or regional endpoints. The OpenAPI document lists only a single server (api.dev.pika.art), with no regional options.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
